sub: Pakistan face Sri Lanka at 6pm, lead series
paragraphs: Pakistan aur Sri Lanka ka doosra T20I aaj **shaam 6 baje** Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium mein khela jayega.
Pakistan teen matches ki series mein **1-0** se aage hai. Aaj jeet gaye to series Pakistan ke naam pakki ho jayegi.
Pehle match mein captain Sahibzada Farhan ne **89 runs** banaye aur Naseem Shah ne **3 wickets** liye. Pakistan ne **4 wickets** se jeeta tha.
Series ka teesra aur aakhri match **13 October** ko hoga.
question: Kya Pakistan aaj series jeet lega?
